messages:
ajay: Heads-up — we're planning a small canary of the new rerank model next Tue 9am PST. Can infra confirm GPU availability across us-west-2 + eu-west-1 for 8x A100-ish instances? Need ~6 machines for 2 hours.

maria: @ajay I can check quotas today. Do you need reserved capacity or just on-demand spot/ond?

ajay: Prefer reserved if possible — want predictable latency. If not, spot fallback is OK but need rollout policy.

tim: Quick sanity check: what instance shape are you targeting? g4dn/pa4/whatever?

ajay: We want equivalent to 80GB A100 (p4d / a100-80GB). Roughly 8 GPUs across 6 hosts (some hosts 1x, some 2x).

lina: Pinging cloud vendor rep in thread for ETA on procurement quotas. @vendor-sales any chance to pre-approve capacity for Tue morning? :wave:

vendor-sales: Hey all — we can try. For reserved it's a 24h approval window for guaranteed allocation. If you submit a quota request now with the following payload we can expedite: 

```
{\n  "region": "us-west-2,eu-west-1",\n  "instance_type": "p4d",\n  "count": 6,\n  "start": "2026-03-24T09:00:00-07:00",\n  "duration_hours": 2\n}
```

vendor-sales: If you'd rather avoid reserved commits, we can mark this as a soft-priority allocation — higher probability but not guaranteed.

maria: I ran the internal quota check: current spare A100 quota in us-west-2 = 4 GPUs, eu-west-1 = 2 GPUs. Docs: https://docs.internal/quotas/gpu. So short by ~2 GPUs total.

ajay: Hmm. Can we repurpose any non-prod pools for the canary window?

lina: There's a nightly batch job using 2x A100s in us-west-2 that we can shift to smaller machines for that window — I'll coordinate with ML batch owners. @tim can you draft the minimal change?

tim: Yep. I can throttle batch to 1 GPU for that 2h window. I'll open a quick PR to the scheduler and tag @maria for quota changes.

ajay: Thanks. Also, can infra provide a fallback model routing config if only 4 GPUs show up? We should degrade to a 2x smaller model rather than fail.

maria: I'll prepare a routing policy in the console (canary -> fallback variant) and a manual rollback runbook. Snippet for rollout policy: 

```
route: canary-rerank
  preferred: p4d-80gb
  fallback: p4d-40gb, cpu-quantized
  threshold.latency_ms: 250
  fallback_after_miss: 30s
```

infra-bot: Scheduled capacity test started (job id: infra-cap-test-20260320-01). Results will post in this thread.

infra-bot: Capacity test complete — us-west-2: 6x p4d available in 2-hour window (after batch throttling). eu-west-1: 2x p4d only.

ajay: Great — that matches needs for us-west-2. For eu-west-1 we'll route to smaller variant. I'll submit the vendor reserved request now.

vendor-sales: Got the request — marking it high priority. Will confirm allocation by EOD.

ajay: Awesome. I'll update the launch doc and add canary rollback steps. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
